glosses: To dissolve (a substance) in ethanol or some other solvent to produce a medicinal tincture.

examples.text: Fill a glass jar full of plant matter, leaving an inch of space. (I prefer to tincture each herb separately and mix combinations as I need them.) Completely cover plants with 100-proof vodka, brandy, or vinegar and secure the lid tightly.

glosses: To have a taint or tinge of some quality.

examples.text: The portrait of the Author, prefixed, is engraved from a drawing by another of his friends, done from memory; it is like, but a likeneſs that tinctures of the prejudice of friendſhip.
